description: Deterministic browser acceptance scenarios for the focused user flow. These cases verify UI behavior and explicit states; they do not measure accuracy.
invariants: A score is labeled Supported share of resolved claims and includes counts and coverage.
Insufficient evidence is shown when the score is null.
OCR uncertainty stays separate from factual verdicts.
Earliest-observed provenance is scoped to the searched scope.
Framing and source signals stay separate from factual scoring.
